chapter: Pianists, Basie, Lil Armstrong and closing
title: Cozy Cole, Stuff Smith and Jonah Jones
summary: He knew Cozy from the Stuff Smith and Cab Calloway days and recalls the crazy antics of Stuff Smith at the LaSalle Hotel.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Well, where did you meet Cozy?
Oh, I met Cozy from the Cab Calloway days. Yeah, when he and Jonah -- I knew Jonah --
That was when Little Joe was popular.
Right, right, right, right. Then I knew him a little before that, because I knew him from the Stuff Smith days.

He and Jonah, right. He and Jonah were in it, see, and that was the band and they used to go -- oh, they used to go crazy, they'd go nuts. What's his name that played here, one of the first black bands to play in the LaSalle Hotel, which is gone now. But they played an engagement down there, and Stuff was there. And Stuff was crazy, he was really a nut. And he had these guys -- he'd see a woman, he'd say I'm going to go over there and kiss her. And he would do it.
Oh, right, right, right. I had some great times with him. And then he -- you talk about Jo Jones being a nut, there's another one. That was his brother, Stuff Smith.
Ezekiah. And he's like Joe, he's got all those names.
Well, you've heard Joe recite his name s la-la-bla-la-la.
